generic_domain.justification:
After analyzing all provided research domains, reinforcement learning (RL) emerges as the most generic and comprehensive domain. RL covers a broad spectrum of problems where an agent learns to make decisions by interacting with an environment and receiving rewards or penalties. It provides a foundational framework that contextual reinforcement learning and visual reinforcement learning build upon.

Contextual RL narrows down the scope by considering contexts that influence decision-making, which is a specific application within the broader RL framework. Similarly, visual RL focuses on scenarios where agents use visual information for making decisions, which again is a specialized subdomain of RL. Thus, RL encompasses both these areas and serves as the most inclusive category.
